society.skycraft.say.region.heartlands: White-Gold Tower catches the first sun off Lake Rumare, even with the Dragonfires cold and the Chancellor holding the Ruby Throne together by parchment.
society.skycraft.say.heartlands.1: Every coin in the Market District passes through the Office of Imperial Commerce before the sun clears the Arboretum.
society.skycraft.say.heartlands.2: You can see White-Gold Tower from every turn of the Red Ring Road, whether you live in Talos Plaza or sleep on the Waterfront.
society.skycraft.say.heartlands.3: Chancellor Ocato keeps the Elder Council in session from dawn till dusk, though half the counties only listen when it suits their ledgers.
society.skycraft.say.heartlands.4: Don't buy unsealed soul gems in the back alleys—the Arcane University proctors have eyes in every shop along the colonnade.
society.skycraft.say.heartlands.5: The Arena Bloodworks roars louder than the Temple bells whenever the Grand Champion takes the sand.
society.skycraft.say.heartlands.6: Rumare mist rolls across the Talos Bridge thick enough to hide a dozen Waterfront smugglers before the Watch changes post.
society.skycraft.say.heartlands.7: A townhouse in Elven Gardens costs more in annual hearth-tax than an entire freeholding out by Aleswell.
society.skycraft.say.heartlands.8: The Imperial Watch patrols the six radial wards in polished steel, but down by the Bloated Float you mind your own purse.
society.skycraft.say.heartlands.9: Since the Oblivion Crisis scarred the Temple District, the stonemasons haven't had an idle day in the capital.
society.skycraft.say.heartlands.10: Every courier from the provinces rides across the western bridge before the morning bells finish ringing.
society.skycraft.say.heartlands.11: Look at the Ayleid foundations under the sewer grates—the Elves laid those white stones a thousand years before Saint Alessia broke the chains.
society.skycraft.say.heartlands.12: In the Arboretum, scholars argue over the Elder Scrolls while beggars fish Septims out of the marble basins.
society.skycraft.say.heartlands.13: The Black Horse Courier prints three editions a week and still can't keep up with the rumours out of the Palace crypts.
society.skycraft.say.heartlands.14: If you want a blade tempered for the road, Rohssan's forge and Slash 'N Smash compete for every legionary's pay-chest.
society.skycraft.say.heartlands.15: Pell's Gate and Weye feed the capital's granaries, one barge load of Rumare carp and heartland wheat at a time.
society.skycraft.say.heartlands.16: The Temple of the One still smells of cold ash and old incense where Martin Septim shattered the Amulet of Kings.
society.skycraft.say.heartlands.17: Even without an Emperor on the throne, the bureaucracy of the Heartlands stamps every manifest in triplicate.
society.skycraft.say.heartlands.18: Watch the slaughterfish if you wade off the island reeds; their scales dull a gutting knife in three strokes.
society.skycraft.say.heartlands.19: The Mages Guild proctors lock the university gates against apprentices who haven't earned every county recommendation.
society.skycraft.say.heartlands.20: Between the Watch captains and the guild factors, nobody climbs the ward ladder in the Imperial City without paying a toll.

society.skycraft.say.region.colovian_hig: Here in the Colovian Highlands the air is dry, the limestone valleys are steep, and a man's word is measured by his guild standing and his oak-beam roof.
Countess Valga keeps Chorrol orderly—pay your Stendarr tithe, honour your guild contract, and keep your sheep off your neighbour's downs.
The Great Oak in Chorrol's plaza has stood through three dynasties; we settle our bargains in its shade.
Colovian wool and karst-seam iron built the Legions long before the Nibenese learned to paint their silk.
Both the Fighters Guild and the Mages Guild answer to strong chapterhouses in Chorrol, though the Blackwood Company tries to poach the desperate.
Stay clear of Hackdirt after sundown—those villagers shutter their windows and mutter over sunken caverns no decent miner would enter.
When the upland wind comes down off the Jerall border, the karst streams vanish underground for three leagues at a stretch.
Weynon Priory's bells carry all the way to the Black Road when the morning air is clear.
Goblin tribes from the pine ridges raid the sheepfolds every autumn unless the County Watch burns their totems.
At Battlehorn Castle and the old ridge keeps, every stone merlon was dressed to hold the northwestern passes.
A Colovian glass of highland cider and a platter of mutton will see you further up the trail than any Nibenese sweet-wine.
The iron mines around Chorrol run deep into the limestone karst; watch your footing where the sinkholes open.
Vilena Donton runs the Fighters Guild chapter with a cautious hand since her son fell in the contract wars.
Teekeeus at the Mages Guild has no patience for hedge-wizards who leave unwarded tomes in the mountain caves.
The Odiil boys still work their fields down by the Weynon road, goblin skirmishes or no.
Every mason in the Highlands knows how to lay grey mountain granite over Ayleid footings without cracking the lintel.
In the Chapel of Stendarr, the healers mend miners' broken ribs and soldiers' shield-arms without asking for noble pedigrees.
Don't trust the isolated hamlets south of the road; too many of them keep their own law behind locked cellar doors.
From Cloud Top down to Brindle Home, the highland pastures feed half the cavalry remounts in western Cyrodiil.
Ayleid ruins like Wendir and Lindai still hum under the pine needles when the nights turn frost-clear.
Here in Colovia we speak plain Tamrielic, wear practical wool, and keep our swords oiled in the hall.

society.skycraft.say.region.jerall_mount: Up in the Jeralls the snow never truly leaves the passes, and Bruma's hearth-fires burn spruce logs three seasons out of four.
society.skycraft.say.jerall_mountains.1: Half of Bruma prays in the Chapel of Talos and the other half swears by Ysmir over a mug of Nord mead at Olav's.
society.skycraft.say.jerall_mountains.2: Countess Narina Carvain collects Akaviri relics from Pale Pass while Captain Burd keeps the frost off the city battlements.
society.skycraft.say.jerall_mountains.3: Above a hundred and fifty paces on the ridge, the blizzard buries road-cairns and Ayleid stones alike.
society.skycraft.say.jerall_mountains.4: Cloud Ruler Temple watches the whole valley from its crag—even without an Emperor, the Blades keep their armour bright.
society.skycraft.say.jerall_mountains.5: Sancre Tor's barrow-vaults have been sealed and unsealed since Reman's day; the wind through its gates sounds like old legions marching.
society.skycraft.say.jerall_mountains.6: If you're bound for Skyrim through Pale Pass, carry twice the firewood and three times the salt pork you think you need.
society.skycraft.say.jerall_mountains.7: The silver seams in the Jerall granite pay well when the adits don't flood with snowmelt.
society.skycraft.say.jerall_mountains.8: Up on Frostcrag Spire, the mages' braziers glow blue against the storm clouds every winter night.
society.skycraft.say.jerall_mountains.9: Bleaker's Way and Ember Hollow survive on hot-spring steam, silver ore, and whatever pack-trains beat the early snows.
society.skycraft.say.jerall_mountains.10: In Bruma we build the lower storey in mountain stone and the upper loft in dark spruce so the snow slides clean off the eaves.
society.skycraft.say.jerall_mountains.11: Ogre packs come down from the high scree whenever the mountain goats move to the lower glens.
society.skycraft.say.jerall_mountains.12: Ongar at Olav's Tap and Tack asks fewer questions about a crate's seal than any clerk in the Imperial City.
society.skycraft.say.jerall_mountains.13: The Great Gate scar outside Bruma's east wall still refuses to grow anything taller than frost-lichen.
society.skycraft.say.jerall_mountains.14: Whether you call him Tiber Septim or Talos of Atmora, his banner flies first on the Jerall ramparts.
society.skycraft.say.jerall_mountains.15: Snowmelt cisterns under Bruma's streets are heated by hearth-flues so the wells never freeze solid in Sun's Dusk.
society.skycraft.say.jerall_mountains.16: Watch the switchbacks below Applewatch—black ice has sent more ore-wagons into the ravine than bandits ever did.
society.skycraft.say.jerall_mountains.17: A Nord smith and an Imperial quartermaster can argue all morning over steel temper and still share a roast boar by nightfall.
society.skycraft.say.jerall_mountains.18: The family crypts cut into the permafrost hold centuries of pass-wardens who died keeping the northern gate shut.
society.skycraft.say.jerall_mountains.19: Smugglers use the old goat-tracks west of Sancre Tor whenever the County Watch doubles the toll at the main gate.
society.skycraft.say.jerall_mountains.20: Wrap your cloak tight before you cross the upper plaza; the wind off the Skyrim crest cuts right through chainmail.

society.skycraft.say.region.great_forest: Beneath the Great Forest canopy of ancient oaks and beech-hangers, the Red Ring roads wind past charcoal clearings and moss-grown Ayleid crowns.
society.skycraft.say.great_forest.1: Step twenty paces off the paved highway in the Great Forest and the oak canopy swallows the sun until noon.
society.skycraft.say.great_forest.2: Charcoal burners and sawyers in Vlastarus know every deer-trail between Chorrol and the Rumare shore.
society.skycraft.say.great_forest.3: Weynon Priory and Gottlesfont keep their lamps lit for travellers, though the deep woods belong to older things after dark.
society.skycraft.say.great_forest.4: Every ridge in the forest hides a broken Ayleid colonnade—Vindasel, Ceyatatar, Fanacasecul—and half of them shelter necromancers.
society.skycraft.say.great_forest.5: The Order of the Black Worm and the Mages Guild have fought a quiet war through these glades for years.
society.skycraft.say.great_forest.6: Foresters say a unicorn still walks the fern-glades at Harcane Grove, guarded by minotaurs that snap iron spears like twigs.
society.skycraft.say.great_forest.7: At Weye and Wawnet Inn, the bridge-tolls and Rumare fishermen mark the boundary where forest shadow meets capital law.
society.skycraft.say.great_forest.8: Minotaur Lords still camp among the white marble stones their ancestors guarded for the Heartland High Elves.
society.skycraft.say.great_forest.9: Don't drink from an unmarked forest spring unless a wayshrine of Kynareth stands on the bank above it.
society.skycraft.say.great_forest.10: Logging teams from Vlastarus travel with hired bowmen—the goblins in the beech-hangers shoot from the branches.
society.skycraft.say.great_forest.11: The old forts—Nikel, Virtue, Wooden Hand—were built to watch the forest roads, and now highwaymen watch the roads from their battlements.
society.skycraft.say.great_forest.12: When the autumn fog settles in the Silverfish headwaters, you can hear axes and chapel bells a league before you see a roof.
society.skycraft.say.great_forest.13: Daedric shrines sit hidden in the deep thickets where the woodfolk leave offerings they won't name in town.
society.skycraft.say.great_forest.14: Heartland oak felled in the Great Forest frames every ships' keel in Anvil and every guildhall beam in Chorrol.
society.skycraft.say.great_forest.15: Keep your horse on the cobbles; the sink-loam under the bracken hides collapsed Ayleid cellars.
society.skycraft.say.great_forest.16: Priory of the Nine still keeps the memory of Pelinal's knights under its stone arches in the southern woods.
society.skycraft.say.great_forest.17: Hunters bring boar-tusks and stag-hides into Wawnet Inn by the cartload whenever the court in the capital holds a feast.
society.skycraft.say.great_forest.18: If you see blue welkynd light flickering through the beech trunks at midnight, turn your wagon around and drive for the inn.
society.skycraft.say.great_forest.19: Charcoal smoke hangs sweet and heavy over the clearings from Heartfire until the first frost.
society.skycraft.say.great_forest.20: The Great Forest is older than the Empire, and the roots under the road remember who built the first stones.

society.skycraft.say.region.nibenay_basi: Where the Corbolo tumbles down from the Valus foothills into Cheydinhal's willow-lined canals, Nibenese silk meets Dunmer ash-exile.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_basin.1: Count Andel Indarys rules Cheydinhal from the castle on the hill—a Hlaalu lord in an Imperial county seat.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_basin.2: Half the signboards along Cheydinhal's canals are carved in Dunmeris, and the taverns pour Morrowind mazte beside Colovian ale.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_basin.3: Watch your purse around Captain Ulrich Leland; his corruption fines have ruined more honest householders than the river floods.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_basin.4: Nobody walks past the abandoned house on the east bank after dark without hearing whispers about the Dark Brotherhood.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_basin.5: Down at Cropsford, the settlers finally raised their Founders' Hall after the goblin tribes at Crestbridge were broken.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_basin.6: High in the Valus foothills, the blind monks of the Ancestor Moth tend their silk-shawls above the pine line.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_basin.7: The Corbolo river turns a dozen weir-mills between Lake Arrius and the Blue Road bridges.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_basin.8: Farwil Indarys and his Knights of the Thorn mean well, even if their chivalry costs more in dented armour than it saves.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_basin.9: Wait until you see Lord Rugdumph's estate—an Orc nobleman in velvet doublets holding court over the foothill pastures.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_basin.10: Around Lake Arrius, the volcanic vents warm the reeds and the deep red caverns hide Mythic Dawn remnants.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_basin.11: In the Chapel of Arkay, the priests keep careful watch over the cemetery vaults where the Valus mists settle.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_basin.12: Orchard apples, plums, and sweet-grain barges float down the Corbolo toward the Heartlands every harvest moon.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_basin.13: Vahtacen's sealed Ayleid pillar-chamber has baffled the Mages Guild scholars since the First Era.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_basin.14: Harlun's Watch keeps its beacon stacked with dry pine whenever swamp-trolls wander out of the southern reeds.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_basin.15: Borba gra-Uzgash runs the cleanest general store in Cheydinhal, and she'll tell you so before you touch the counter.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_basin.16: Rythe Lythandas's studio in Cheydinhal turns out canvases that hang in half the manors of the Nibenay Basin.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_basin.17: The Valus border keeps—Farragut, Scinia, Naso—still guard the Morrowind passes where the old border wars were fought.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_basin.18: Nibenese gentry love their painted gables, steeped tea, and genealogies that trace back to the Alessian primate-houses.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_basin.19: In Larkmarsh and Swallowcliff Mill, the weir-keepers trap river-eels by lantern light when the Corbolo runs high.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_basin.20: Cheydinhal looks like a watercolor painting from the willow bridges, provided you know which alleys to avoid.

society.skycraft.say.region.west_weald: On the warm limestone slopes of the West Weald, Skingrad's high stone bridges arch over narrow streets perfumed with pressed grapes and garlic.
society.skycraft.say.west_weald.1: Count Janus Hassildor never descends to the city streets, yet Skingrad is the richest, best-policed county in Cyrodiil.
society.skycraft.say.west_weald.2: Whether you swear by Surilie Brothers or Tamika's West Weald vintage, never praise one in the other's tasting room.
society.skycraft.say.west_weald.3: Skingrad's double walls and high stone arches make the main street feel like a fortress canyon.
society.skycraft.say.west_weald.4: Across the western hills, the pale stones of Miscarcand rise out of the oak savanna where the Great Welkynd Stone once shone.
society.skycraft.say.west_weald.5: Salmo's sweetrolls at the bakery draw couriers off the Gold Road from three leagues away.
society.skycraft.say.west_weald.6: If Glarthir stops you behind the Great Chapel of Julianos at midnight, nod politely and keep walking.
society.skycraft.say.west_weald.7: The limestone terraces catch the afternoon heat and hold it through the night—that's why West Weald grapes ferment so clean.
society.skycraft.say.west_weald.8: At the Priory of the Nine in the southern woods, the old Crusader armour still rests beneath the chapel flagstones.
society.skycraft.say.west_weald.9: Every estate hamlet from Ivy Shade to Shardrock keeps its own stone cistern and cooperage shed.
society.skycraft.say.west_weald.10: Falanu Hlaalu at All Things Alchemical stocks rarer reagents than half the apothecaries in the capital.
society.skycraft.say.west_weald.11: The Gold Road carries Anvil salt-fish west and Skingrad wine-casks east from dawn until the gate-chains go up.
society.skycraft.say.west_weald.12: Rosethorn Hall is the finest timber-and-stone manor in the upper ward, if you have the Septims to satisfy Shum gro-Yarug.
society.skycraft.say.west_weald.13: The Mages Guild in Skingrad specialises in destruction magic, and Count Hassildor gives them wide berth—for a price.
society.skycraft.say.west_weald.14: Shepherds on the oak savanna watch for goblin raiders coming down from the Valenwood marches.
society.skycraft.say.west_weald.15: In the Chapel of Julianos, the scholars copy legal codes and vineyard charters side by side.
society.skycraft.say.west_weald.16: Don't ask the castle stewards why Count Hassildor only receives petitioners by candlelight; Sinderion's cellar is safer company.
society.skycraft.say.west_weald.17: Tomato rows, lavender borders, and cypress windbreaks mark every West Weald freeholding.
society.skycraft.say.west_weald.18: The old Ayleid name-vaults under the vineyards—Talwinque, Niryastare, Varondo—were built from the same cream limestone as our cellars.
society.skycraft.say.west_weald.19: Two Sisters Lodge and the West Weald Inn compete for every wine-merchant's caravan that halts inside the gates.
society.skycraft.say.west_weald.20: Keep your cart-wheels greased on the Skingrad hill; the cobblestones are steep and the Watch fines blocked axles.

society.skycraft.say.region.gold_coast: Where the dry golden hills drop down to the Abecean cliffs, Anvil's sandstone harbour gleams in the salt spray while Kvatch smoulders on its mesa.
society.skycraft.say.gold_coast.1: Anvil's lighthouse guides ships from Stros M'Kai, Summerset, and Valenwood into the crescent harbour every night.
society.skycraft.say.gold_coast.2: Up on the mesa at Kvatch, Savlian Matius and his guardsmen are raising timber scaffolds over the blackened stones of the siege.
society.skycraft.say.gold_coast.3: Countess Millona Umbranox rules Castle Anvil while watching the sea-horizon for a husband who vanished years ago.
society.skycraft.say.gold_coast.4: Down on the Anvil docks, the Flowing Bowl smells of tar, spiced rum, and Redguard sailors arguing over Abecean freight rates.
society.skycraft.say.gold_coast.5: Behind the Great Chapel of Dibella, the priests still whisper about the Prophet's sermons and the lost shrine of Garlas Malatar.
society.skycraft.say.gold_coast.6: Don't buy a bargain manor in Anvil without asking why Velwyn Benirus left town in such a hurry.
society.skycraft.say.gold_coast.7: West of the Gold Road stands Crowhaven—a ruined fort where Lord Lovidicus's tragic bloodline left a dark stain on the coast.
society.skycraft.say.gold_coast.8: Smugglers use the sea-caves at Dunbarrow Cove to land contraband before the harbour customs clerks wake up.
society.skycraft.say.gold_coast.9: Between Brina Cross and Gottshaw Inn, the Gold Road winds through dry olive scrub and sun-bleached Ayleid arches.
society.skycraft.say.gold_coast.10: Norbert Lelles swears his shop is haunted every third night, though the Fighter's Guild suspects flesh-and-blood thieves.
society.skycraft.say.gold_coast.11: Morvayn's Peacemakers hammers out cutlasses and boarding-axes for every merchantman that sails past the headland.
society.skycraft.say.gold_coast.12: Refugees from Kvatch still camp along the switchback road, waiting for the Great Chapel of Akatosh to be roofed again.
society.skycraft.say.gold_coast.13: When the westerly gales blow off the Abecean, salt spray coats every red-tile roof in Anvil's outer ward.
society.skycraft.say.gold_coast.14: At Gweden Farm on the southern bluff, wise travellers keep their hands on their hilts and avoid the siren talk.
society.skycraft.say.gold_coast.15: The Mermaid of Anvil fountain in the harbour square has seen a hundred pirate truces and merchant charters signed.
society.skycraft.say.gold_coast.16: In Kvatch, every scorched stone we pull from the Arena ring goes straight into rebuilding the lower curtain wall.
society.skycraft.say.gold_coast.17: Gold Coast sandstone carves like butter in the quarry and hardens like iron once the sea-wind cures it.
society.skycraft.say.gold_coast.18: Quill-Weave writes her chronicles from Anvil's sunlit balconies while the dock-cranes creak below.
society.skycraft.say.gold_coast.19: Watch the cliff-paths at low tide; wreckers with false lanterns still work the shoals north of Fort Strand.
society.skycraft.say.gold_coast.20: From the Gold Road crest at sunset, the Abecean Sea turns the exact colour of a newly minted Septim.

society.skycraft.say.region.nibenay_vall: Along the humid, braided channels of the Lower Niben, Bravil's stacked plank tenements lean over muddy canals and reed-choked ferries.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_valley.1: Count Regulus Terentius cares more for his feasts in Castle Bravil than the rotting planks on the canal bridges.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_valley.2: Everyone in Bravil touches the Statue of the Lucky Old Lady for good fortune—though the Dark Brotherhood knows what lies beneath her.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_valley.3: Keep your nose out of the skooma den behind the eastern canal unless you want your pockets turned inside out.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_valley.4: The Lower Niben braids into a dozen reed-islands where barges pole through river fog thick as wool.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_valley.5: along the Green Road, the Inn of Ill Omen and Faregyl Inn shelter drovers who won't risk the river-mist after dusk.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_valley.6: In the Chapel of Mara, the healers spend half their mornings treating marsh-ague and skooma shakes.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_valley.7: Bravil's upper stories connect by plank catwalks because the mud below floods every time the Niben rises.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_valley.8: At Lunar Fang Docks and Cold Dale, the customs clerks weigh moon-sugar crates from the Elsweyr border with one eye shut.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_valley.9: Daedra-worshippers and rogue conjurers hide in the riverbank ruins—Wenyandawik, Culotte, and Nenyond Twyll.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_valley.10: Never accept an invitation to a private hunt on Fort Grief's island; Kurdan gro-Dragol's bargains only go one way.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_valley.11: Khajiit and Argonian dockhands pole the grain-scows from Nibenay Bay up to the Heartlands locks.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_valley.12: The Archer's Paradox in Bravil sells the finest reed-fletched arrows and river-ash bows in southern Cyrodiil.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_valley.13: City-Swimmer knows every loose floorboard and smuggler's mooring along the Bravil waterfront.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_valley.14: When the summer heat settles into the valley, the willow-carrs hum with gnats and mudcrabs the size of shields.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_valley.15: Gellius Terentius drinks away his father's county treasury while the Watch sergeants take bribes at the north gate.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_valley.16: Three mills along the valley streams—Cold Brook, Echo Hill, and Thalara's—grind wet-meadow rye for the river towns.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_valley.17: The Western and Eastern Elsweyr Gates still stand across the southern road where the jungle border begins.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_valley.18: Henantier's dream-experiments at the Bravil Mages Guild have given the whole canal street strange nightmares.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_valley.19: A flat-bottomed skiff and a ten-foot pole will get you further in the Nibenay Valley than a warhorse ever could.
society.skycraft.say.nibenay_valley.20: Mind the green slime on the canal steps; one slip in armour and the Niben mud will keep you.

society.skycraft.say.region.blackwood: Down in Blackwood the air is hot as a washhouse, cypress roots twist through black peat, and Leyawiin's lime-washed walls straddle the mouth of the Niben.
society.skycraft.say.blackwood.1: Count Marius Caro and Countess Alessia want Leyawiin to look like the Imperial City, even if the mangroves grow right up to the moat.
society.skycraft.say.blackwood.2: The Blackwood Company Hall in Leyawiin takes contracts the Fighters Guild won't touch—and nobody asks what's in their sap-vials.
society.skycraft.say.blackwood.3: Down in Border Watch, the Khajiit shamans read the moons while rain drums on their reed-thatch roofs.
society.skycraft.say.blackwood.4: Water's Edge and Blankenmarch sit on cypress pilings above the brackish tide where the Niben meets Topal Bay.
society.skycraft.say.blackwood.5: Argonian reed-cutters in Blackwood still leave offerings at the hollow Hist-stumps deep in the swamp.
society.skycraft.say.blackwood.6: In the Great Chapel of Zenithar, merchants pray for dry cargo holds and honest mercenary escorts.
society.skycraft.say.blackwood.7: Walk five minutes east of the Blue Road and the thunderstorms roll off Black Marsh with lightning that splits the swamp-cypresses.
society.skycraft.say.blackwood.8: Sunken Ayleid vaults like Telepe, Veyond, and Nenalata are half-drowned in black peat and guarded by marsh-undead.
society.skycraft.say.blackwood.9: Weebam-Na and Bejeen can track a marsh-boar through three feet of tidewater without splashing a boot.
society.skycraft.say.blackwood.10: Countess Alessia Caro's dinner parties are the talk of the inner ward, though the beastfolk shanties outside the east gate tell another story.
society.skycraft.say.blackwood.11: At the White Stallion Lodge, Mazoga and the knight-errants hunt Black-Brugo's bandits through the riverside ruins.
society.skycraft.say.blackwood.12: Rice paddies, reed-weirs, and mud-brick kilns keep the Blackwood hamlets fed when the thunderstorms wash out the roads.
society.skycraft.say.blackwood.13: Watch the deep pools around Fort Blueblood and Fort Redwater; will-o'-the-wisps lure travellers off the causeways.
society.skycraft.say.blackwood.14: Rosentia Gallenus paid a fortune for her collection of Daedric curios, and she'd pay twice that to be rid of the scamps.
society.skycraft.say.blackwood.15: The Panther River mouth is littered with the ribs of wrecked coasters that misjudged the Topal sandbars.
society.skycraft.say.blackwood.16: In Three Sisters' Inn and the Five Claws Lodge, you'll hear Kothringi river-tales, Khajiiti proverbs, and Imperial garrison songs.
society.skycraft.say.blackwood.17: Lime-washed plaster peels fast in the Blackwood steam-heat, so the masons repaint Leyawiin's gables every spring.
society.skycraft.say.blackwood.18: Mangrove vampires in the eastern fens fear only fire-salts and the midday sun.
society.skycraft.say.blackwood.19: Every barge that clears the Niben mouth pays harbour dues at Leyawiin's east bridge before sailing into Topal Bay.
society.skycraft.say.blackwood.20: Keep dry tinder in a waxed horn if you camp in Blackwood; even the firewood sweats water down here.
react.blackwood.dragon_slayer: They say you slew a dragon in the northern sky—here in Blackwood, folks haven't spoken of dragon-blood like that since the day Martin Septim lit the Temple of the One.
society.skycraft.react.blackwood.dragon_: They say you slew a dragon in the northern sky—here in Blackwood, folks haven't spoken of dragon-blood like that since the day Martin Septim lit the Temple of the One.
react.blackwood.companion_member: A shield-brother of Whiterun's Companions? Our Fighters Guild chapter in Blackwood respects anyone who earns their coin with cold steel.

react.blackwood.college_member: A scholar of Winterhold's College? The Mages Guild in Blackwood would gladly trade notes with someone who doesn't answer to the Arcane University proctors.

react.blackwood.thieves_member: Word travels fast along the beggar-posts of Blackwood—the Gray Fox's shadow reaches every counting-house from the Waterfront to our county gates.

react.blackwood.brotherhood_member: Keep your voice low in Blackwood; folks who walk in Sithis's shadow know the Night Mother's crypts are closer than the Watch thinks.
